semantics.resolution_rule: Output is produced from the resolved DWH schema/semantic target.
semantics.schema_rule: Output fields/types follow the declared resolved schema.
semantics.relation_rule: Relation-based remote resolution requires predeclared relation/FK semantics.
semantics.raw_rule: Raw remote source state is not exposed as canonical output unless explicitly modeled.
semantics.taint_rule: Output preserves applicable lineage and taint after resolution.
semantics.authority_rule: Output release still requires applicable authorization/policy.

invariants.rule: DWH scope, release, remote access and policy decisions remain explicit, provenance-preserving and separate from transport reachability.
